newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on long liquidation.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended steeply below New York's Thursday close after long liquidation and sales from Tokyo traders, bullion dealers said on Friday.
Bullion ended at US$344.20/70 an ounce against New York's $345.35/85 close on Thursday.
Long liquidation in morning trade and sales from Tokyo traders pushed gold down, dealers said, adding it was further depressed by European sales during the afternoon session.
Gold clung to its bearish note and dealers saw support at $340 to $341 per ounce. Physical demand stayed brisk, they said.
Local gold ended HK$28 lower at HK$3,203 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to nil from its previous fix at -4.00.
